title: PasswordReset Bug Dana-i Ver. 3.0.0.2
body:
Bug Info here: [https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/1916](url)

...Password is empty after reset, not SN...

After Reset I set no new Pw (leave it empty). I make an Export of my Settings. Now i want to Import my Settings and get the info that my file is manipulated, no Import.
What can i do, to get my settings back.

I try do re-install the app no success.

comments.body: sorry you cannot make export without password (it's used for encryption)

Export with empty password, after Reset works. 

During Import i have to insert 2 times the empty Password. It ends with a popup windows.

There is no chance to get the done objectives back?
I tested current version 3.1 now and export with empty password is not possible

Export with empty password works in 3.0.0.2. You fixed this bug in 3.1 that sounds good. 

Sorry, but i need an import with empty password.

My export-file has about 520 lines of settings, do you need this?

Is there a rescue option?
sorry, no idea what you did and what to do now because master password is used for encryption
